description: Collectible voice effect: A tiny, quick, very high voice. Applied to the speech voice (pitch 2, speed 1.3).
prompt: A kid-friendly 'Chipmunk' voice preset for the built-in speech voice: A tiny, quick, very high voice. Choose a pitch (0–2) and a speed (0.1–10) that sound clearly different from the normal voice but stay easy to understand, plus one emoji icon shown when no voice is available.
